subject: Service rider & order-form language for Medicrix – signoff path
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: procurement@medicrix.com <procurement@medicrix.com>
Cc: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@medicrix.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service rider & order-form language for Medicrix – signoff path

Hi Matthew / Medicrix procurement team,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Attached are the redlines we discussed to the MSA/SOW (Medicrix_MSA_SOW_redlines.pdf) and an initial draft of order-form language that codifies the availability commitments and exception carve-outs. High-level items we want to confirm from your side: 

- Availability target: 99.95% regional availability, with an explicit carve-out for planned maintenance windows and force majeure.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 500ms for inference responses on the standard instance profile; regional surge routing exceptions defined below.
- Credit calculation: service credit percentage tied to monthly region-level uptime in the Order Form (we included a sample table).
- Fallback / degraded mode: automatic failover to a compatible model variant in-region; cross-region failover only as an opt-in addendum.

Ask: please confirm whether Medicrix requires the cross-region failover to be mandatory for your production traffic flow (that impacts capacity planning and pricing), and whether your legal team has a preferred DocuSign routing template so we can push the exhibit and order form through the right flow.

If helpful, Ben can propose conservative wording for the order form that limits the exception scope to the three production regions you listed during the call.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm cross-region failover requirement and DocuSign template.
2) We exchange a v2 of the order-form language (Ben + Marissa to produce).
3) We route final exhibit via DocuSign.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Medicrix_MSA_SOW_redlines.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
From: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@medicrix.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@medicrix.com <procurement@medicrix.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@medicrix.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service rider & order-form language for Medicrix – signoff path

Hannah —

Thanks for sending these over. A few clarifications from our side after an initial review: 

- Cross-region failover: we'd like this to be available but not mandatory. We want the option to enable automatic cross-region failover for DR drills, but we will default to in-region where latency matters.
- Credits: Medicrix prefers a tiered credit schedule with a floor. Can you include a worked example for a 30-day month so procurement can run the numbers against our internal cost model?
- Latency SLO: the 500ms p95 target is acceptable, but our ML infra team wants the SLA to explicitly call out measurement scope (e.g., excluding model warm-up or customer-induced long prompts).
- DocuSign template: please route the final exhibit through our procurement@medicrix.com DocuSign account and use the attached template (Medicrix_Docusign_Template.docx). Olivia (cc) will be the legal approver.

Also copying Olivia for legal redlines. Olivia — please flag any non-starter language early.

Would appreciate Ben's suggested order-form phrasing. Once we have v2 I can share with our head of procurement for signoff.

Thanks,
Matthew
Matthew Lee
Procurement Manager, Medicrix
matthew.lee@medicrix.com

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Service rider & order-form language for Medicrix – internal suggested language

Hannah — quick internal note (do not forward external yet):

I drafted conservative order-form language that:
- Restricts the cross-region failover exception to opt-in only (customer toggles in the order form).
- Defines Availability Credits as: (1 - (region_downtime_minutes / total_region_minutes)) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals, with a cap of 30% of monthly fees.
- Latency carve-out: exclude agent-triggered long-prompt sessions and initial model cold starts (first 5 minutes after deployment or model swap).

Attachment: proposed_orderform_language_v2.txt (plain text) — includes a sample worked example for a 30-day month.

Recommendation: propose the worked example and the credit cap to procurement as a compromise. It keeps our exposure bounded while giving Medicrix the predictability they want. If Olivia pushes back on the cap, we can escalate to legal for a one-time carveout for enterprise customers on annual contracts.

Let me know and I'll iterate to v3.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@medicrix.com>, procurement@medicrix.com <procurement@medicrix.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@medicrix.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service rider & order-form language for Medicrix – signoff path

Matthew / Olivia —

Thanks for the quick review and the DocuSign template. Ben and Marissa and I discussed and we put together a compromise build attached: REDWOOD_Medicrix_SLA_Exhibit_v3.pdf. Key points in v3:

- Cross-region failover remains opt-in on the order form. We added a checkbox in the Order Form sample to enable automatic cross-region failover for production traffic.
- Availability Credits: we included the worked example for a 30-day month and set a 30% monthly fee cap as Ben recommended.
- Latency SLO exclusions: specified explicit exclusions for model warm-up (first 5 minutes post-deploy) and long-prompt sessions initiated by the customer; measurement windows and probe methodology are included in Appendix A of the exhibit.
- Evidence & audit: we will provide monthly region-level uptime reports and tenant-level traces for incidents; SOC-2 audit artifacts can be shared under an NDA if needed.

DocuSign routing: please use the Medicrix template and route to procurement@medicrix.com -> Olivia Park (Legal) -> Matthew Lee (Procurement) -> Hannah Schmitt (Sales) -> Ben Carter (Sales Ops) as a final reviewer. Here is the DocuSign envelope link to seed once you confirm: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-123456789

If Olivia has legal redlines, happy to take them. If this looks acceptable, please confirm and we will seed the DocuSign envelope and prepare the final order form for signature.

Best,

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
